title: Figure 2: Impact of Air-Breathing Rocket, all-rocket vs. LACE configurations and aerospike
description: Line drawings comparing an "All Rocket" vehicle and a "LACE Rocket" vehicle side by side, with a tabulated comparison below ("5.35 ton payload"; 334 vs. 101 ton TOGW, 28.6 vs. 15.9 ton OEW, 678 vs. 428 m² S_plan). At right is an "Aero Spike Konstantin Feotkiskov" nozzle drawing with "Under expanded" and "Over expanded" plume annotations. Caption: "Figure 2. Impact of Air-Breathing Rocket." Appears in a "Propulsion Perspective" section on hypersonic gliders.
